title: int:UserAccount
description: Platform access record for an Actor. One-to-one with Actor. Created during D3.2 User Onboarding workflow.

accountId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: foaf:accountId. UUID v4.

actorId.description: FK to owning Actor (unique). IRI: int:actorId. UUID v4.

username.description: Unique login identifier. Typically Actor primary email. Case-insensitive. IRI: int:username.

accountStatus.description: Operational status of the platform account. IRI: int:accountStatus.

kycVerified.description: KYC verification completed. Gates financial transactions. IRI: int:kycVerified.

createdAt.description: Account creation timestamp. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

lastLoginAt.description: Last successful login timestamp. NULL until first login. IRI: int:lastLoginAt.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp. IRI: int:updatedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
